The Regional Maritime Exchange fosters research and analysis among Australian and Southeast Asian maritime security experts. It is delivered by a consortium of Australian institutions comprising La Trobe Asia, University of Western Australia Defence and Security Institute, University of New South Wales (ADFA), Griffith Asia Institute and Asia-Pacific Development, Diplomacy & Defence Dialogue under the Blue Security banner. In July 2024, Blue Security delivered a workshop in Manila for 9 early career researchers (ECR’s), including 5 women, from Southeast Asian countries to enhance regional collaboration and increase informed public debate on international maritime law, legal processes and mechanisms with an emphasis on UNCLOS. The workshop, part of an ongoing series delivered by Blue Security for ECR’s, provided participants the opportunity to present their own research and receive feedback from pre-eminent maritime law and security experts. The outcomes from the workshop include 3 papers published under the Blue Security: A Maritime Affairs Series and 6 op-eds published on a range of highly respected international policy platforms. The workshop strengthened and supported regional research collaboration amongst next-generation maritime scholars, contributing to an expanding regional network under the program, and providing a template for future workshops.
